content: .{@-भग@} {%a.%} .²1 very fortunate or prosperous, happy, blessed, highly favoured. .²2 lovely, charming, beautiful, pretty; न तु ग्रीष्मस्यैवं सुभगमपराद्धं युवतिषु <ls>Ś. 3. 9</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 34</ls>; <ls>R. 11. 80</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9</ls>. .²3 pleasant, grateful, agreeable, sweet; दिवसाः सुभगादित्याश्छायासलिलदुर्भगाः <ls>Rām. 3. 16. 10</ls>; श्रवणसुभग <ls>M. 3. 4</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 3</ls>. .²4 beloved, liked, amiable, dear; सुमुखि सुभगः पश्यन् स त्वामुपैतु कृतार्थताम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²5 illustrious. .
